title: Demo tenant QA bugs tracker (dry runs + field feedback)
content:
Purpose
- Lightweight tracker for issues discovered during demo dry runs + live prospect demos using the demo tenant.
- This is not the system of record (that’s Linear/Jira/GitHub). This doc is the SE-friendly “what’s broken / what to avoid / what to retest” view.

How to use
- When an issue is found, add a row with: steps, impact, severity, and the “demo workaround” (what to do in the moment).
- Create/attach the canonical ticket (Linear/Jira) + any PRs.
- Mark status as: New → Triaging → In Progress → Fixed (needs retest) → Verified → Closed.
- If it’s a showstopper (S0/S1), post in #sales + tag @Markus Klein and @Sean Gallagher.

Severity definitions (demo-specific)
- S0: Cannot complete core demo path (API call fails; cannot login; tenant not accessible).
- S1: Can complete demo with a workaround, but it is visible/brittle and risks credibility (empty dashboards; severe throttling; streaming fails).
- S2: Degrades polish or affects one module (rollouts view flaky; a secondary chart wrong; minor latency spikes).
- S3: Cosmetic / copy / “would be nice to have”.

Tracker (most recent updates at top)
Columns: ID | Date found | Scenario | Summary | Severity | Status | Owner | Demo workaround | Repro steps | Expected vs actual | Links | Notes / retest

B-041 | 2026-02-19 | Reliability (fallback routing) | Fallback demo sometimes routes to a model variant that changes output structure (JSON key names drift), breaking the “structured output” beat | S1 | Fixed (needs retest) | Mina Haddad | Use backup screenshot set “fallback-routing-annotated-v2”; avoid asserting exact JSON keys if running live | 1) Run tool-calling scenario runner 3x in a row 2) Force region failover via policy toggle 3) Observe structured output schema | Expected: same JSON schema across fallback; Actual: compatible model family but JSON keys differ | Linear: ENG-4840; GitHub: redwood/pr-28502 | Retest after next model catalog refresh + ensure prompt set pins schema. Add a “schema guard” assertion in demo app.

B-040 | 2026-02-13 | Console (observability dashboards) | Cost breakdown chart sometimes defaults to empty project after reset (looks like “no traffic”) | S1 | Verified | Chloe Martin | In Console, manually re-select project “demo-seeded-app” and set time range to “Last 60 minutes” | After running reset: open Console → Cost → Token breakdown | Expected: seeded project auto-selected; Actual: blank selection → empty graphs | GitHub: redwood/pr-28644; Jira: SUP-4189 | Verified in staging; production demo tenant verified 2026-02-14.

B-039 | 2026-02-10 | Provision/reset | Reset command returns success but leaves 1–2 stale API keys active (least-privilege policy violation risk) | S0 | In Progress | Devon Price | Immediately run key rotation helper; do not share previously generated keys | Run demo-reset CLI → check keys list in Console/CLI → observe old keys still valid | Expected: old keys revoked; Actual: old keys still work for ~30–60 min | Linear: ENG-4855; GitHub: redwood/pr-28577 | Suspected async revocation job lag. Need deterministic revoke + healthcheck check.

B-038 | 2026-02-06 | Hosted API (streaming) | Streaming disconnects in EU region under moderate concurrency (demo “feels flaky”) | S1 | Triaging | Sean Gallagher | Switch region to us-east for live demo; keep EU screenshots for narrative | Start 3 parallel streaming chats (browser + python + ts) in eu-west | Expected: stable SSE stream; Actual: intermittent disconnect after ~10–30s | Jira: SUP-4302 | Capture traces + confirm if proxy idle timeout. Track as demo Sev2 when it happens within 24h of scheduled EMEA demo.

B-037 | 2026-02-03 | Core API demo (tool calling) | Demo app sometimes retries tool call and duplicates side effect in the “inventory lookup” example | S2 | Fixed (needs retest) | Renee Sullivan | Use “dry-run mode” tool endpoint that returns deterministic result (no side effects) | Run scenario runner with retries enabled; observe 2 tool invocations | Expected: idempotent tool call; Actual: double call when request is retried | GitHub: redwood-examples/pr-193 | Need to re-check demo script talk track: mention idempotency best practice.

B-036 | 2026-01-29 | Console (rollouts view) | Canary/A-B view loads but the “comparison” table takes ~20–30s to populate; awkward silence during demo | S2 | In Progress | Logan Wright | Pre-load rollouts page before joining call; use annotated screenshot if it spins >10s | After reset, open Console → Rollouts → “demo-route-canary” | Expected: table within 5–8s; Actual: delayed aggregation | Linear: ENG-4879; GitHub: redwood/pr-28610 | Possible cold cache on analytics query. Consider pre-warming job after reset.

B-035 | 2026-01-22 | Parallel demos | Two SEs running demo simultaneously caused cross-contamination of dashboards (traffic showed in the wrong project) | S0 | In Progress | Mei Lin | Until namespaces ship: allocate separate projects per demo (“demo-a-*”, “demo-b-*”) and confirm in healthcheck report | Run synthetic traffic generator while two keys active; observe mixed metrics | Expected: strict project isolation; Actual: dashboards aggregate incorrectly due to shared route tag | Linear: ENG-4894; Slack ref: sales/1741789910 | Root cause likely shared tag in telemetry ingestion. Add “demo_session_id” tag in generator.

B-034 | 2026-01-16 | Auth/RBAC | SE role mapping in demo org drifted; Markus could not access org settings (RBAC misconfigured) | S0 | Closed | Ethan Park | Use break-glass admin group (Security-approved) to restore role mapping; then re-run healthcheck | Attempt to open Org → Members/SSO; 403 | Expected: SE has OrgAdmin; Actual: role missing | Jira: INT-993 | Add guardrail to healthcheck endpoint: validate required roles for demo group.

B-033 | 2026-01-10 | Economics demo (batching/caching) | “Enable caching” toggle appears but effect size is inconsistent (sometimes no visible cost drop) | S2 | Triaging | Ravi Menon | If deltas don’t show in 2 minutes: switch to canned run output (saved traces + charts) | Run baseline prompt set → toggle caching → rerun | Expected: lower prefill tokens + lower unit cost; Actual: sometimes flat | Linear: ENG-4833 | Might be due to prompt distribution shifting + small sample size. Need deterministic prompt set + fixed concurrency.

B-032 | 2026-01-08 | Capacity/quotas | Demo tenant hits 429s during live call with modest load (2–3 concurrent streams + dashboard seed job) | S1 | Verified | Sean Gallagher | Pause synthetic traffic generator during live demo; increase quota preset to “demo-standard” | Run demo + generator simultaneously; observe 429 responses | Expected: demo workload fits quotas; Actual: throttling | Jira: SUP-4127; GitHub: redwood/pr-28691 | Verified after quota preset update + rate limits on reset endpoint.

B-031 | 2025-12-18 | Model pinning | Pinned model version became unavailable after catalog cleanup; demo route failed to resolve | S0 | Closed | Mina Haddad | Switch to fallback route “demo-chat-latest-stable”; use backup recording if routes fail | Attempt chat completion on pinned route | Expected: pinned model resolvable; Actual: 404 model version | Linear: ENG-4840; GitHub: redwood/pr-28502 | Added “allowed fallbacks” policy + monitoring for catalog changes.

B-030 | 2025-12-11 | Console dashboards | Empty dashboards after reset (no seeded traffic / ingestion lag) | S1 | Closed | Mei Lin | Run synthetic traffic generator preset “demo-populate-15m”; refresh time range | Reset tenant → open Console charts | Expected: charts populated; Actual: empty graphs | Linear: ENG-4833; GitHub: redwood/pr-28488; Jira: SUP-4189 | Primary fix: generator + healthcheck verifies ingestion freshness.

B-029 | 2025-12-03 | Reset automation | Demo reset takes 18–25 minutes under load; SEs can’t reliably turn around between calls | S1 | Verified | Devon Price | Start reset 30 minutes before call; if late, use backup mode (screenshots/recording) | Run reset during business hours | Expected: <5 minutes; Actual: 18–25 min | Linear: ENG-4862; GitHub: redwood/pr-28531 | Healthcheck report helps; still need performance improvements for parallel demos.

B-028 | 2025-11-26 | SDK snippets | Python snippet in talk track uses deprecated param name; causes confusion when copy/pasted | S2 | Closed | Monica Patel | Use updated snippet from internal demo guide; do not live-type | Copy snippet → run | Expected: works; Actual: error/warning | Slack ref: devex/1741972207 | Fixed in snippet source; pin SDK versions for demo.

B-027 | 2025-11-18 | Security narrative | “Audit logs” page includes internal-only event types (could raise unnecessary questions in external demo) | S2 | In Progress | Naomi Feldman | Only show filtered view: auth events + key rotations; avoid internal system events | Navigate to Audit Logs default view | Expected: customer-relevant events; Actual: noisy internal events visible | Confluence: demo-security-faq; Slack ref: sales/1741705594 | Add demo-friendly saved filter + permission-gated event categories.

B-026 | 2025-11-12 | Dedicated-style controls (quotas) | Quota UI labels don’t match sales language (“capacity units” vs “tokens/sec”), leading to back-and-forth mid-demo | S3 | Triaging | Soojin Lee | Use “translation” line in talk track: “think of this as reserved throughput” | Show quota page | Expected: aligned terminology; Actual: mismatch | Drive: demo-pricing-and-credits-guidance | Consider UI copy update (post-demo rollout) + talk track tweak.

Backlog / ideas (not bugs yet)
- Add a demo-mode banner + “this is synthetic data” watermark in Console (ask: Dylan Brooks).
- Pre-warm analytics queries after reset to avoid awkward spinners.
- Add a “demo session” selector to keep parallel demo data clean.
- Add one-click “Generate fresh traffic for 5 min” button for SEs (avoids CLI).

Open questions
- Do we want a hard rule that the traffic generator pauses automatically when a human demo session starts?
- Who owns weekly retest cadence (SE on-call rotation vs Eng Platform)?

Retest checklist (quick)
- [ ] Reset completes < 5 minutes
- [ ] Healthcheck: quota OK, pinned models resolvable, dashboards ingestion fresh
- [ ] Core chat streaming stable in us-east and eu-west
- [ ] Tool calling scenario: no duplicate tool calls under retries
- [ ] Console: Cost/Latency/Error dashboards show activity in last 60 minutes
- [ ] Rollouts view: canary comparison table populates within ~10 seconds
